_note: Verified against Robinhood Chain (4663) on 2026-08-31 via blockscout. Three contracts are named 'PoolManager'; only one is canonical. Uniswap v4 is a singleton, so the real PoolManager custodies every pool's liquidity — 8,877 ETH. The other two hold zero ETH and only memecoins: they are copies deployed by meme-launch factories. Picking one of those would swap into empty pools while every local test still passed.
